answer: The brick maker strikes his mould on the bench, and the strike is heard across the whole yard. Proof of net maker knot via mesh gauge record is the striking: a net the maker knots only after 60 meshes gauge true, each mesh tried on the wooden gauge. The knoll is the strike, the nadir is the mould, and the hollow is the bench itself, worn smooth by twenty years of strikes. A cheat must strike 41 false moulds on 41 false benches, and the yard still hears no sound from his hands.
